about.behavior: Massive pelagic migrator that travels along deep oceanic fronts and Gulf Stream boundaries.
about.timing_note: Patterns reported by local captains and fishing writers, not tested by studies.

factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Archival-tag data report Atlantic bluefin tuna occupying 10–23 °C for most of the record, with peak occupancy around 13–20 °C; ICCAT analyses report broad adult and juvenile temperature ranges. This supports the configured 12–24 °C range and 16–22 °C ideal as broad species-level conditions, but temperature use varies by stock, life stage, season, and dive depth; it is not a single South Florida SST optimum.
